title: Propeller Tip
body: A propeller blade at rest starts to rotate from $$t=0\, \text{s}$$ to $$t=5.0\, \text{s}$$ with a tangential acceleration of the tip of $$3.00\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}**{2}}$$. $$The$$ $$tip$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$blade$$ $$is$$ $$1.5\, \text{m}$$ from the axis of rotation.
lesson: 4. Motion in Two and Three Dimensions
